prompt: This repo has a Shopify-style webhook handler in handler.go. Two bugs: (1) when processing fails it still responds 200 so the platform never retries — failed processing must respond 500; (2) HMAC verification compares signatures with == on raw strings after decoding only one side — requests with an invalid signature must be rejected with 401 before any processing. Fix both. Do not change process.go. Run go test ./... to check your work.
